P3.name: Associates help — How do I build a simple text link to a specific item on Amazon?

rows.claim: ASIN is a 10-character code; the documented simple link format is amazon.com/dp/ASIN?tag=YOURASSOCIATEID
rows.value: Quoted: "ASIN is the 10-digit code that Amazon uses to denote specific products."
Quoted verbatim: "As an Amazon Associate I earn from qualifying purchases." Required to be stated clearly and prominently on the Site (OA §5).

rows.claim: Violating OA §5 is a material breach
rows.value: Quoted: any violation of Section 5 "will be deemed a material breach of this Agreement" (OA §6(a)).

rows.claim: Special Links must use Amazon's tagged link formats and carry the Associates ID
rows.value: Quoted (OA §1): links "must properly use the special 'tagged' link formats we provide and comply with this Agreement ('Special Links')."

Participation Requirements §6(a): 'You will not add to, delete from, or otherwise alter any Program Content in any way…'. Price and availability are Program Content, obtained under the IP License through Creators API or PA API (License §2(b)-§2(c)), so they may not be republished from an arbitrary fetch. §6(y) additionally: 'Unless otherwise agreed by Amazon, your Site must not have price tracking and/or price alerting functionality.'
rows.note: Re-read verbatim on 2026-11-14 by session 0a3dff48, directly from the Program Policies page (https://affiliate-program.amazon.com/help/operating/policies, 'Updated: April 14, 2026'). Price and availability are visible on the live product pages; they are withheld here because they are Program Content, not because they are unverifiable. See C-4.

rows.value: Participation Requirements §6(t): 'You will not display or otherwise use any of our customer reviews or star ratings, in part or in whole, on your Site unless you have obtained a link to that customer review or star rating through Creators API or PA API and you comply with the requirements for Creators API and PA API described in the License.'
